brute.sound: huge swamp ogre, very deep gravelly bass, gruff but friendly
brute.fits: blunt checks and verdicts, anything that should feel strong and no-nonsense

tags.description: A short grunt before a verdict or when starting a task.
A low growl when something looks bad or suspicious.
A deep chuckle when something is good news.

sounds.arrive: heavy footsteps thudding closer and a deep friendly ogre growl
sounds.working: big creature rummaging through a pile of rocks and wood, steady rhythmic digging
sounds.done: heavy wooden club thumping on the ground twice

gremlin.sound: tiny goblin, extremely high-pitched squeaky nasal voice, impish
gremlin.fits: quick lookups, prices, deals, anything playful or fast

tags.description: A quick giggle when starting or when the news is good.
A short hiss when something is a bad deal or a scam.
A mischievous cackle when revealing a finding.

sounds.arrive: tiny goblin scurrying across a wooden floor and a squeaky gleeful giggle
sounds.working: small creature rapidly scribbling and rustling papers, tiny claws tapping
sounds.done: tiny bell jingling and a squeak

lich.sound: ancient undead sorcerer, dry hollow whispery voice, aristocratic
lich.fits: deep research, records, history, anything that should feel ancient and knowing

tags.description: Whisper the first few words of a secret or warning.
A cold sigh when the findings disappoint.

sounds.arrive: stone crypt door grinding open with a cold echoing wind
sounds.working: pages of an ancient book turning in a quiet echoing crypt, faint candle crackle
sounds.done: a single deep chime echoing in a stone hall

golem.sound: massive stone golem, booming deep resonant voice, calm and simple
golem.fits: reading and summarizing, steady reliable reports

tags.description: A low rumble before speaking a result.
A short grunt to acknowledge a request.

sounds.arrive: large stone blocks grinding and a deep rumble as a golem wakes
sounds.working: slow heavy stone grinding and gravel shifting, steady rhythm

hag.sound: old swamp witch, crackly sly elderly voice, conspiratorial
hag.fits: shopping and reviews, scams, gossip, anything about who to trust

tags.description: A witchy cackle when revealing a juicy finding.
Whisper a warning or a secret.

sounds.arrive: creaking wooden cottage door and a witch's sly cackle
sounds.working: thick potion bubbling in an iron cauldron with a crackling fire
sounds.done: a cork popping out of a glass bottle with a magical shimmer

igor.sound: hunchbacked lab assistant, eager high-pitched manic voice, Eastern European accent
igor.fits: creative and content work, generating things, anything experimental

tags.description: Excited delivery for the first words of a result.
A nervous giggle when starting a task.
A gasp before a surprising finding.

sounds.arrive: electrical sparks crackling and a laboratory machine powering up
sounds.working: busy mad science laboratory, bubbling beakers and humming electrical coils
sounds.done: a big electrical zap followed by a triumphant ding

swarm.sound: insect hive creature, buzzing raspy voice with hissing sibilants, alien
swarm.fits: monsters that check many things at once: competitors, lists, social accounts

tags.description: Insect clicking when starting or switching topics.
A hiss when something is a threat or a bad sign.

sounds.arrive: a swarm of insects buzzing closer and clicking mandibles
sounds.working: busy insect hive humming and buzzing, many tiny legs scurrying
sounds.done: the buzzing swarm suddenly stopping with a single sharp click

butler.sound: undead zombie butler, posh British voice with a raspy decaying throat, polite
butler.fits: briefings, meeting prep, scheduling, anything formal or service-like

tags.description: Clear the throat politely before presenting a result.
A small undead groan when starting a task.

sounds.arrive: old mansion door creaking open and a polite servant bell ringing
sounds.working: grandfather clock ticking in a quiet old mansion, quill scratching on paper
sounds.done: a silver service bell ringing once
